title: fix: serve app_top_weekly from an hourly Tinybird snapshot
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The seven-day app ranking is now computed hourly into the Tinybird `app_top_weekly_snapshot` table. `app_top_weekly`, which the Hello and Apps pages call from the browser, reads the snapshot instead of scanning about 0.69 GB of `generation_event_v2` on every request. Rankings can be up to an hour old; the SQL, attribution rules, columns, limit, and caller interface are unchanged. The public stats documentation was updated to describe the snapshot.
